excerpt.zh: 通过伪装成帝国低级职员或是官僚，我们的特工现已成功渗透进[target.GetName]内部。
excerpt.en: Concealed as low-level Imperial officials and bureaucrats, our operatives are now infiltrating the [target.GetName].

texts.zh: 通过伪装成帝国低级职员或是官僚，我们的特工现已成功渗透进[target.GetName]内部。
texts.en: Concealed as low-level Imperial officials and bureaucrats, our operatives are now infiltrating the [target.GetName].

texts.zh: 我们的特工盯上了一位长期热衷于公开批判帝国的特使，并着手处理这危险的星星之火。
texts.en: Our operatives are shadowing an envoy that has long been an outspoken critic of the Imperium. Work is underway to deal with this dangerous firebrand.

texts.zh: 这位目标小心行事，尽可能表现得不像是在发表公开反动言论，但他的所作所为的确在损害我们的权威。单纯的外交声明挽回不了他们，不过我们有的是办法来对付这些叛乱分子。
texts.en: The target is careful not to make statements that could be interpreted as fomenting open sedition against the Imperium, but their activities are still undermining our authority. Diplomatic eloquence will not save them in the end - there are other ways of dealing with rebels.

texts.zh: 我们已经收集到了足够多的证据来清除目标了。由于其反动颠覆的行径，他们不受外交豁免权的保护，并将作为帝国的敌人在帝国法院的审判席上受审。
texts.en: We have gathered enough evidence to move against the target. Their subversive activities negate whatever diplomatic immunity they may have enjoyed - they will be tried and sentenced in an Imperial court as an Enemy of the Imperium.

texts.zh: [target.GetName]通过外交手段削弱帝国权威的主导者是一个自律[target.GetIndividualName]。我方特工确信抹除这位个体将消解反动者在帝国参议院中对于[target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的影响。
texts.en: The efforts of the [target.GetName] to diplomatically undermine the Imperium largely hinge on the activities of a single autonomous [target.GetIndividualName]. Our operatives are confident that the elimination of this envoy will negate whatever seditionist influence the [target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have in the Imperial Senate.

texts.zh: 帝国代理人成功在[target_country.GetName]将该反动特使逮捕。目标被迅速引渡到[Root.GetName]，在快速审判后被判处死刑。这就是抹黑[Root.GetRulerTitle]的代价。
texts.en: Imperial agents were successful in their attempt to apprehend the subversive envoy in the [target_country.GetName]. The target was quickly transported to the [Root.GetName], and after a swift trial they were sentenced to death. Such is the price for besmirching the good name of the [Root.GetRulerTitle].

texts.zh: 一支隶属于帝国安全总局的战术小队成功在[target_country.GetName]拘押了这位反动特使。特勤干员迅速将其引渡至[Root.GetName]，其在快速审判后被判处死刑。这就是抹黑[Root.GetRulerTitle]的代价。
texts.en: A tactical team from the Imperial Security Directorate was successful in its attempt to apprehend the subversive envoy in the [target_country.GetName]. The ISD agents quickly transported the target to the [Root.GetName], and after a swift trial they were sentenced to death. Such is the price for besmirching the good name of the [Root.GetRulerTitle].

texts.zh: 在一场精心准备的伏击后，埋伏好的帝国特工们将目标乱枪击毙，并在当地执法机关反应过来前迅速逃离。尽管[target_country.GetName]怀疑我们一手策划了枪击，但他们并没能找到证据。这将给那些蔑视[Root.GetRulerTitle]的人敲响警钟。
texts.en: In a carefully planned ambush, concealed Imperial operatives gunned down the target and then made their escape before the local authorities could respond. Although the [target_country.GetName] likely suspects our involvement, there is no proof for them to find. This will send a powerful message to those who would defy the [Root.GetRulerTitle].

texts.zh: 在一场精心准备的伏击后，一支来自帝国安全总局的战术小队将目标乱枪击毙，并在当地执法机关反应过来前迅速逃离。尽管[target_country.GetName]怀疑我们一手策划了枪击，但他们并没能找到证据。这将给那些蔑视[Root.GetRulerTitle]的人敲响警钟。
texts.en: In a carefully planned ambush, a tactical assault team from the Imperial Security Directorate gunned down the target and then made their escape before the local authorities could respond. Although the [target_country.GetName] likely suspects our involvement, there is no proof for them to find. This will send a powerful message to those who would defy the [Root.GetRulerTitle].

tooltips.zh: [target_country.GetName]在接下来的5年内无法派遣特使执行削弱帝国权威的任务。
tooltips.en: The [target_country.GetName] may not assign Envoys to Undermine Imperial Authority for the next 5 years.

texts.zh:
帝国特工不久前以“意图推翻帝国”的罪名逮捕了一位我们的特使！特使在我们有关部门介入前就被快速引渡至[From.GetName]，并在一场简短的审判后被判处死刑。

这位特使的死亡使得我们之前在参议院内的游说成果功亏一篑。我们需要一些时间来重建必要的外交平台以继续左右帝国的公共舆论。
texts.en:
Imperial agents recently arrested one of our envoys for "crimes against the Imperium"! The envoy was swiftly transported to the [From.GetName] before our own authorities could react, and after a brief show trial a death sentence was meted out.

The death of this envoy has severely compromised our lobbying efforts in the Imperial Senate. It will be some time before we regain the necessary diplomatic platforms needed to sway public opinion in the Imperium.

texts.zh:
一支来自帝国安全总局的强袭小队刚刚以“意图推翻帝国”的罪名拘捕了一位我们的特使！特勤干员们在我们有关部门介入前迅速将其引渡至[From.GetName]。经过一场简短的审判后，特使被宣判死刑。

这位特使的死亡使得我们之前在参议院内的游说成果功亏一篑。我们需要一些时间来重建必要的外交平台以继续左右帝国的公共舆论。
texts.en:
A strike team from the Imperial Security Directorate recently arrested one of our envoys for "crimes against the Imperium"! The ISD agents swiftly transported the envoy to the [From.GetName] before our own authorities could react, and after a brief show trial a death sentence was meted out.

The death of this envoy has severely compromised our lobbying efforts in the Imperial Senate. It will be some time before we regain the necessary diplomatic platforms needed to sway public opinion in the Imperium.

texts.zh:
我们的一位特使刚刚在[Root.Capital.GetName]被暗杀！凶手逃脱了追捕，但鉴于该特使是[From.GetRulerTitle]及帝国的公开批评家，谁最有策划这次暗杀的动机已经再清楚不过了。

这位特使的死亡使得我们之前在参议院内的游说成果功亏一篑。我们需要一些时间来重建必要的外交平台以继续左右帝国的公共舆论。
texts.en:
One of our envoys was recently assassinated on [Root.Capital.GetName]! The perpetrators eluded capture, but our envoy was an outspoken critic of the [From.GetRulerTitle] and the Imperium - it is very clear who had the most to gain by their demise.

The death of this envoy has severely compromised our lobbying efforts in the Imperial Senate. It will be some time before we regain the necessary diplomatic platforms needed to sway public opinion in the Imperium.

label.zh: 难道“外交豁免权”只是一张厕纸吗？

tooltips.zh: 在接下来的5年里我们无法派遣特使执行削弱帝国权威的任务。
tooltips.en: We are unable to assign Envoys to Undermine Imperial Authority for the next 5 years.

texts.zh:
我们扰乱[target_country.GetName]以削弱帝国权威的行动受挫！[target_country.GetAdj]的反情报部门一定已经监视了我们的一举一动——我们所有的密探全部失联。

[target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]已经向帝国参议院提交了我们行动的证据。我们的外交官正竭力否认每一点，但显然，这尴尬的解释一定会在[Root.GetRulerTitle]面前显得苍白无力。
texts.en:
Our operation to disrupt the ability of the [target_country.GetName] to undermine the Imperium has been compromised! [target_country.GetAdj] counterintelligence must have been monitoring our every move - all of our operatives have gone silent.

The [target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have presented evidence of our operation to the Imperial Senate. Our diplomats are denying everything, of course, but this embarrassing incident will reflect poorly on the [Root.GetRulerTitle].

texts.zh:
[Root.Capital.GetName]的几名帝国间谍试图让我们的特使们闭嘴——更具体来说，阻止他们削弱帝国的权威——这一企图最近被我方瓦解了。

我们将这一帝国参议院策划的肮脏阴谋公之于众。当然，[From.GetRulerTitle]的那群马屁精对一切予以否认，但这一事件毫无疑问将抹黑帝国试图对外宣传的那副团结鸿图。
texts.en:
Several Imperial agents were recently neutralized on [Root.Capital.GetName] while engaged in an apparent attempt to silence our Envoys - more specifically, to prevent them from undermining the authority of the Imperium.

We have exposed the details of this dastardly plot to the Imperial Senate. The lackeys of the [From.GetRulerTitle] are denying everything, of course, but this incident will distort the image of unity the Imperium is trying to project.
